generation.prompt_exact:
Create ONE 1536 x 1024 production sprite sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha, arranged in a generous 2 by 2 grid with exactly FOUR isolated complete matching traditional PICKET FENCE parts. The two attached images are existing project-generated STYLE/MATERIAL references only: detailed naturalistic pixel-art wood texture, warm upper-left light, deliberate stepped pixel clusters and restrained weathering. They are NOT desired objects: do not draw a bench or lattice trellis. New fence design is warm off-white painted wood with small subdued aged-light-wood wear patches and matte gray iron hardware. Quiet practical domestic yard boundary, no graphic outlines, no glossy3D, no UI.

CRITICAL CONSISTENT PHYSICAL SCALE ACROSS ALL FOUR QUADRANTS: use a shared target160 source pixels per metre. Picket height is1.0m, therefore about160 pixels high; post height1.1m, therefore about176pixels including flat cap. The2m infill should be about320pixels wide, and1m gate leaf about160pixels wide. The smaller gate and post MUST remain smaller instead of growing to fill their cells. Keep these physically sized objects relatively small in the large1536x1024 sheet, centered within their own quadrants, with generous fully empty transparent padding. Cell positions roughly TL center[384,256], TR center[1152,256], BL center[384,768], BR center[1152,768]. All tips/hardware fully visible, no frame contact.

Camera shared: frontal yard-boundary view, only slight top visibility to show wood thickness and flat post caps; verticals remain upright, NO dramatic isometric angle. Straight section and gate share a horizontal ground baseline and straight perspective. Authentic detailed small-square PIXEL ART and cohesive paint/wood/hardware across every part.

TOP LEFT: ONE2m straight traditional pointed-top off-white wooden PICKET INFILL SECTION, approximately320px wide by160px tall. Exactly TWO horizontal supporting rails behind spaced individual vertical pickets. NO end posts and no gate hardware. Rail ends terminate cleanly at the two section endpoints; picket feet form one level baseline. Real transparent open spaces between pickets and above/below rails; do not paint a solid white panel. No third rail, no foot plinth or ground slab.

TOP RIGHT: ONE1m CLOSED matching PICKET GATE LEAF, approximately160px wide by160px high. Only the leaf itself, NO surrounding frame and NO frame/end posts. Matching picket spacing/profile and two rails, with visible small gray iron hinge straps at upper/lower LEFT leaf edge and a small latch at the RIGHT leaf edge. It is a static closed leaf, no open-state duplicate. Do not put a large post behind the hinge or latch. Real alpha gaps between every picket.

BOTTOM LEFT: ONE90degree corner assembly in plan, made from TWO matching short1m picket infill arms meeting at EXACTLY ONE SINGLE central CORNER POST. Post1.1m/176px, each arm1m long at shared160px/m before foreshortening. Modest front/slight top perspective makes one arm recede; visibly an L corner, never a straight section or V fantasy fence. Two rails per arm. ONLY ONE flat-capped corner post at the junction; ABSOLUTELY NO POSTS at either free outer endpoint. The cap is a small horizontal FLAT square top with slight bevel, NO pointed pyramid cap. Ground contacts align to the modest depth of the two arms. Real transparent picket gaps.

BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE standalone matching square wooden POST,1.1m/about176pixels high, roughly12–16pixels wide, with the same small FLAT square top cap as the corner post. Flat cap horizontal and visible as a possible small-bird perch, not a spike or pyramid. Straight upright isolated post, no rails, no attached pickets, no metal base frame or feet slab.

All FOUR are static rigid source sprites. NO birds/people/animals, plants, flowers, grass, scenery, soil, background, checkerboard, text, labels, guides or panels. No extra parts, no duplicated posts. No cast-ground rectangles. Everything outside the actual material silhouettes and every open picket gap is truly transparent alpha, not a painted checker pattern or flat color. Preserve complete individual objects and broad empty gutters.
